name: Chunk-Based World Management & Asynchronous Loading
aliases: Async Chunk Streaming, Chunk Culling and Unloading, chunk garbage collection, far chunk removal
definition: Manages a voxel world by dividing it into fixed-size chunks, loading them asynchronously based on player proximity, and removing distant chunks to manage memory and rendering load.
summary: Chunk-Based World Management & Asynchronous Loading divides voxel worlds into fixed-size chunks, loading them asynchronously based on player proximity to prevent frame drops during high-demand generation phases.
